audit_declarations.declaration:
theorem DosenPetric.Palomar.maximality.{u} {P : Type u} [Nonempty P] (R : DosenPetric.Palomar.PrimitiveCongruence P)
  (closed : DosenPetric.Palomar.PrimitiveCongruence.Closed R) {A B : DosenPetric.Formula P}
  (f g : DosenPetric.Presentation.Term P A B) (hne : Not (DosenPetric.Presentation.Derives f g))
  (hfg : DosenPetric.Palomar.PrimitiveCongruence.Rel R f g) : DosenPetric.Palomar.PrimitiveCongruence.Total R
audit_declarations.name: DosenPetric.Palomar.maximality

audit_declarations.declaration:
theorem DosenPetric.Palomar.congruence_dichotomy.{u} {P : Type u} [Nonempty P] (R : DosenPetric.Palomar.PrimitiveCongruence P)
  (closed : DosenPetric.Palomar.PrimitiveCongruence.Closed R) :
  Or
    (∀ {A B : DosenPetric.Formula P} (f g : DosenPetric.Presentation.Term P A B),
      Iff (DosenPetric.Palomar.PrimitiveCongruence.Rel R f g) (DosenPetric.Presentation.Derives f g))
    (DosenPetric.Palomar.PrimitiveCongruence.Total R)
audit_declarations.name: DosenPetric.Palomar.congruence_dichotomy

audit_declarations.declaration:
theorem DosenPetric.Palomar.identity_ne_zero.{u} {P : Type u} (p : P) :
  Not
    (DosenPetric.Presentation.Derives (DosenPetric.Presentation.Term.id (DosenPetric.Formula.var p))
      (DosenPetric.Presentation.Term.zero (DosenPetric.Formula.var p)))
audit_declarations.name: DosenPetric.Palomar.identity_ne_zero

audit_declarations.declaration:
theorem DosenPetric.Palomar.no_top_to_bot.{u} (P : Type u) :
  Not (Nonempty (DosenPetric.Presentation.Term P DosenPetric.Formula.top DosenPetric.Formula.bot))
